issues.description: The UML in the problem statement declares getTotalNumberOfStudents() as returning String, but the intended implementation (solution) defines it as returning int and uses it in numeric contexts (e.g., computing students per tutor). This mismatch can confuse students about the expected return type and whether numeric operations should be performed on the result.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the return type consistent. Update the UML in problem_statement.md to declare getTotalNumberOfStudents(): int (and any related textual hints), so it matches the intended numeric behavior and the solution implementation. Alternatively, if a String return was intended, change the solution and template guidance to return a String and adjust usages accordingly (e.g., parse integers before numeric operations).
